fusions.name: Pounce From Below
fusions.desc: Surfaces under a target up to 6 tiles away for 26 damage, rising to 1.8 times that at full reach. It always strikes critically and leaves the target [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Fathom Purr
fusions.desc: A deep purr deals 11 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns them for 1 second. You regain 8 health.

fusions.name: Afternoon Doze
fusions.desc: Restores 4 mana a second for 8 seconds, and you regain 8 health at once.

fusions.name: Eight Lives Left
fusions.desc: Once your health falls below 25%, you regain 5 health a second for 8 seconds. Once every 90 seconds.
